items.name: tour
items.title: Product Tour
items.description: A fully-engineered guided product tour system with overlay, floating card, keyboard navigation, and media support. Drop-in replacement for building interactive onboarding flows.
items.author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>
items.docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/tour. Wrap your app with TourRoot, attach TourAnchor to any element, and use TourTrigger to start the tour.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: A fully-engineered command palette system with fuzzy search, keyboard navigation, grouped results, source tabs, filter tabs, and a Raycast-style footer. Global ⌘K shortcut included.
items.author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>
items.docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/command-palette. Use CommandPaletteRoot as the provider, CommandPaletteTrigger to open it, and pass your sections as structured data.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File Upload
items.description: A fully-engineered file upload system with drag-and-drop, per-file progress tracking, validation, error states, retry logic, and cancel support. Consumer-provided upload function keeps it backend-agnostic.
items.author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>
items.docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/file-upload. Use FileUploadRoot as the provider and supply your own onUpload function. Supports S3, Cloudinary, or any custom endpoint.

items.name: form-engine
items.title: Form Engine
items.description: A step orchestration engine for multi-step and single-step forms. Owns the flow — you own the fields. Bring any validation library via plugins, or wire in your own form state with FormEngineStep.
items.author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.pxxl.click>
items.docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/form-engine. Use FormEngine for a batteries-included experience with config-driven fields, or FormEngineRoot for headless mode. The engine manages step flow, validation gates, and submission — you bring the fields and state. Plugins extend lifecycle hooks for validation, analytics, and more.

items.name: sortable
items.title: Sortable
items.description: A headless drag-to-reorder system built on @dnd-kit. Supports whole-row drag or handle-only mode, custom drag overlays, vertical list and grid layouts, and a useSortableList hook for typed list mutations.
items.author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>
items.docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/sortable. Wrap your list with SortableRoot, mark each row with SortableItem, and optionally add SortableHandle for grip-only drag. Pass config={{ layout: 'grid' }} for grid layouts. Use useSortableList for typed list state.

items.name: palette
items.title: Palette
items.description: A visual color palette editor with a 2D HSV picker, sortable swatch grid, color naming, and one-click export to hex arrays, CSS custom properties, Tailwind config, or HSL strings.
items.author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>
items.docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/palette. Drop PaletteRoot anywhere for the full editor, or compose with PaletteGrid, PaletteToolbar, and PaletteColorEditor manually. Use usePalette for programmatic control inside any child component.

items.name: properties-panel
items.title: Properties Panel
items.description: A Figma-style properties panel with collapsible sections and seven typed control rows — text, number with unit, color, select, toggle, slider, and custom. Config-driven or fully headless.
items.author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>
items.docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/properties-panel. Pass a sections array to PropertiesPanel for config-driven rendering, or compose PropertiesSection and PropertiesRow directly for headless control. Both modes work simultaneously.

items.name: tree
items.title: Tree View
items.description: Recursive hierarchical data display with full keyboard navigation (arrow keys, Home/End), animated expand/collapse, multi-select, and optional connecting lines.
items.author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>
items.docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/tree. Pass nodes to TreeRoot. Keyboard navigation works automatically when the tree container is focused. Use config.multiSelect for multi-select and config.showLines for connecting lines.

items.name: gallery
items.title: Gallery
items.description: An image gallery system with a sortable grid layout, drag-and-drop upload support, and a fullscreen lightbox viewer with navigation controls.
items.author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>
items.docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/gallery. Drop GalleryRoot anywhere for the full editor, or compose with GalleryGrid, GalleryToolbar, and GalleryLightbox manually. Use useGallery for programmatic control inside any child component.

items.name: spotlight
items.title: Spotlight Search
items.description: Async content search with category tabs, debounced API calls, AbortController cancellation, recent search history, and skeleton loading. Distinct from Command Palette.
items.author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>
items.docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/spotlight. Wrap your app with SpotlightRoot, provide categories and an onSearch function. The / hotkey and modal are wired automatically.

items.name: checklist
items.title: Onboarding Checklist
items.description: A floating onboarding checklist with step dependencies, localStorage persistence, animated progress ring, and inline or floating widget modes.
items.author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>
items.docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/checklist. Wrap your app with ChecklistRoot and pass steps. The floating widget renders automatically. Use position: 'inline' and children to compose your own layout.

items.name: kanban
items.title: Kanban Board
items.description: A multi-container drag-and-drop board with a virtual state machine. Drag cards between columns, reorder columns, live placeholders during drag — committed once on drop.
items.author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>
items.docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/kanban. Wrap your board with KanbanRoot and pass columns and cards. Drag cards within and between columns, drag column headers to reorder. useKanban exposes the virtual drag state for custom column/card rendering.

items.name: cropper
items.title: Image Cropper
items.description: Dual coordinate spaces, eight-handle drag with aspect ratio enforcement, rule-of-thirds overlay, and offscreen canvas export at full image resolution.
items.author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>
items.docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/cropper. Wrap your app with CropperRoot and pass src and onCrop. The default layout renders a toolbar with aspect ratio presets, a canvas with the overlay, and a live preview panel. Pass children to compose your own layout using the same useCropper hook.

items.name: cursors
items.title: Collaborative Cursors
items.description: Real-time presence overlay with conflict-free position sync, idle detection, and a label overlap resolver that prevents names from stacking.
items.author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>
items.docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/cursors. Wrap your shared surface with CursorsRoot and CursorCanvas. CursorsRoot holds state and exposes the imperative update API. CursorCanvas is the tracking surface — it measures mouse position, normalizes it, and calls onMove. Use the useCursors hook to wire your transport with updateCursor and removeCursor.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable Panels
items.description: Split-pane layouts with smooth drag-to-resize, min/max constraints, and collapsible panels. Zero re-renders during drag — CSS custom properties handle all position updates.
items.author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>
items.docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/resizable. Wrap panels with ResizableRoot, add a ResizablePanel for each pane, and a ResizableHandle between them. Configure direction, min/max sizes, and collapse behavior via config. Use useResizable for programmatic control inside any child component.

items.name: audio-visualizer
items.title: Audio Waveform Visualizer
items.description: Real-time Web Audio frequency and waveform analysis rendered as bars, an oscilloscope wave, or a circular spectrum. Connects to any <audio>/<video> element, a MediaStream (mic input), or an AudioBuffer.
items.author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>
items.docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/audio-visualizer. Wrap your player with AudioVisualizerRoot and a config. Call connect() with an HTMLMediaElement, MediaStream, or AudioBuffer from useAudioVisualizer, resume() the AudioContext from a user gesture, then start(). Renders bars, wave, or circular modes on a canvas that fills its container.

items.name: canvas
items.title: Infinite Canvas
items.description: Pannable, zoomable whiteboard surface with rubber-band multi-select and drag. Pan and drag write directly to the DOM for zero-re-render performance — React only renders what's inside each node.
items.author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>
items.docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/canvas. Wrap your surface with CanvasRoot, render CanvasViewport inside it, and pass nodes rendered through CanvasNodeView. Use useCanvas for programmatic pan/zoom/selection control from any child component.

items.name: diff-viewer
items.title: Diff Viewer / Merge Editor
items.description: Line and word-level diffing built on a real Myers algorithm implementation, plus three-way merge with per-conflict accept-ours/accept-theirs resolution. Split or unified view, foldable context.
items.author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>
items.docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/diff-viewer. Pass two strings to DiffViewerRoot for a line/word-level diff, or three (base, ours, theirs) for a merge editor with per-conflict resolution. DiffViewerLayout renders split or unified view with foldable unchanged context.

items.name: notification-center
items.title: Notification Center
items.description: Queued, grouped notification system with priority-based toast eviction, pause-on-hover timing, undo, and a persistent inbox separate from the transient toast queue.
items.author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>
items.docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/notification-center. Wrap your app with NotificationRoot, render NotificationToastViewport for the transient toast queue and NotificationInbox for the persistent list. Use useNotifications to push, group, undo, and dismiss notifications from anywhere in the tree.

items.name: card-select
items.title: Card Select
items.description: A card-based selection control supporting single or multi-select, with grid, list, and scroll layout modes. Used by FormEngine's FieldRenderer and usable standalone.
items.author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>

items.name: chip-select
items.title: Chip Select
items.description: A pill chip selector control supporting single or multi-select. Used by FormEngine's FieldRenderer and usable standalone.
items.author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>

items.name: rating-field
items.title: Rating Field
items.description: A star or number rating input control. Used by FormEngine's FieldRenderer and usable standalone.
items.author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>

items.name: select-field
items.title: Select Field
items.description: A searchable dropdown with grouped options support. Used by FormEngine's FieldRenderer and usable standalone.
items.author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>

items.name: tag-input
items.title: Tag Input
items.description: A tag creation input control with keyboard support for adding and removing tags. Used by FormEngine's FieldRenderer and usable standalone.
items.author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>
